evidence: Source review against native build 1: Ticket, conversation, artifact, error, owner authentication, deployment status, and default executor-health contracts retain their existing fields. APIClient.executorHealth still calls the unparameterized health route for the original executor. This change adds no native Linux destination interface. Registration accepts an optional platform for operator-selected artifact delivery. Existing registrations default to darwin. Linux publication metadata is optional and does not replace existing Mac publication fields. Native owner-facing deployment status remains unchanged. Protocol 26, per-machine credentials, and retained vps/macos aliases remain. Linux install commands, archive role checks, and systemd service control do not change native client routes. The minimum native build, draft/outbox code, reconnect paths, and APNs payloads remain unchanged. Source review, local unit coverage, the shared transport integration coverage, and the Linux artifact Worker/stop proof support retaining build 1. Real iOS device, TestFlight, native Linux destination controls, native reconnect, and native draft survival are not tested. This receipt establishes source compatibility rather than device or production readiness.
